'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[2021 Kandahar bombing]], [[2021 Kunduz mosque bombing]]
***The [[Taliban]] says that they will step up security at [[Shia Islam in Afghanistan|Shi'ite]] [[mosque]]s after [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|ISIS–K]] bombed [[mosque]]s in [[Kunduz]] and [[Kandahar]] this month, killing over 120 people in total. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-pledge-step-up-security-shiite-mosques-after-fridays-attack-2021-10-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Two workers are killed by gunmen in [[Srinagar]] and [[Pulwama]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], in a spike of civilians being killed by rebels in the area. [https://www.greaterkashmir.com/todays-paper/front-page/non-locals-again-targetted-2-shot-dead-in-srinagar-pulwama (Greater Kashmir)]
**A [[Lashkar-e-Taiba]] commander and another militant are killed during a gunfight with security forces in Pulwama. The killed commander, who was involved in the murder of two policemen, was among the top 10 targets of Jammu and Kashmir police. It is also announced that two more rebels, involved in the recent killings of civilians, were killed yesterday during a gunfight in Srinagar. [https://www.indiatoday.in/amp/india/story/j-k-encounter-security-forces-terrorists-pulwama-let-commander-trapped-1865357-2021-10-16 (India Today)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Twenty [[Boko Haram]] militants and three [[Nigerian Army]] soldiers are killed during a gunfight as the military has tried to recapture the [[Nigeria]]n town of [[Maiduguri]]. [http://saharareporters.com/2021/10/17/scores-boko-haram-terrorists-killed-military-insurgents-clash-maiduguri (Sahara Reporters)] 
*[[Murder of David Amess]]
**Yesterday's killing of [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MP]] Sir [[David Amess]], who was [[Assassination|stabbed to death]] in a [[Methodist]] church in [[Leigh-on-Sea]], [[Essex]], is declared as a [[Terrorism|terrorist incident]] by [[Essex Police|police]].  [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-58935372 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Bali earthquake]]
**Three people are killed and seven are injured as a 4.8 [[list of earthquakes in Indonesia|earthquake]] hits [[Bali]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/16/moderate-earthquake-rocks-bali-killing-at-least-3 (Al Jazeera)]
*Eleven people [[drowning|drown]] during a [[school outing]] for a river clean-up in [[West Java]], Indonesia. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/16/11-students-drown-during-river-clean-up-in-west-java (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tasmania]]
****Southern [[Tasmania]], including the state capital of [[Hobart]], enters a [[COVID-19 lockdown|lockdown]] after an increase in locally transmitted [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/oct/15/hobart-and-southern-tasmania-enter-snap-three-day-covid-lockdown (The Guardian)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Russia]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 1,002 deaths from COVID-19, which is the first time that the country has reported more than 1,000 COVID-related deaths in a single day since the [[pandemic]] began. Only 32% of the population has been fully [[COVID-19 vaccination in Russia|vaccinate]]d, amid wide distrust in vaccines. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211016-russia-tops-1-000-daily-virus-deaths-for-first-time (France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**Seven activists are [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to prison terms ranging from six to twelve months' imprisonment for protesting against the national security law in July 2020. Among those sentenced are [[Leung Kwok-hung]] and [[Figo Chan]]. Leung is currently serving two sentences of 18 months' imprisonment for other charges and Chan is currently serving a sentence of 18 months' imprisonment for unauthorized assembly. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/16/seven-hong-kong-activists-jailed-over-unauthorised-protest-in-2020 (Al Jazeera)] [https://gbcode.rthk.hk/TuniS/news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1615491-20211016.htm?spTabChangeable=0 (RTHK)]
*Argentine federal judge [[María Romilda Servini]] indicts post [[Francoist Spain|Franco-era Spanish]] minister [[Rodolfo Martín Villa]] on four counts of homicide. Villa, who resides in Spain, says that he will appeal the decision of the Argentine judge. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/judge-indicts-franco-era-spanish-minister-for-four-charges-of-homicide/47033840 (SwissInfo)]
*An unidentified armed gang kidnaps 15 American [[missionaries]] and their families in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/15-us-missionaries-and-family-kidnapped-in-haiti-local-security-source-01634440807?refsec=afp-news (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*Colombian businessman [[Alex Saab]] is [[Extradition law in the United States|extradited]] to the United States from [[Cape Verde]] ahead of an initial court appearance in [[Florida]] on October 18 over his alleged [[money laundering]] for the [[Government of Venezuela|Venezuelan government]]. [https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/colombian-businessman-alex-saab-extradited-to-us-justice-department-1041362.html (AFP via ''Deccan Herald'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of France|French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] condemns the [[Paris massacre of 1961]] on the eve of its 60th anniversary, but does not issue a formal apology. Macron is the first French president to attend a memorial ceremony for the victims. [https://www.wionews.com/world/macron-condemns-inexcusable-crackdown-on-1961-paris-protest-of-algerians-421375 (AFP via WION)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**[[Shenzhou 13]] launches on a [[Long March 2F]] rocket from the [[Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center]] in the [[Gobi Desert]], [[Inner Mongolia]], for the [[Tianhe core module|''Tianhe'' core module]] of the [[Tiangong space station|''Tiangong'' space station]], where the crew will stay for six months. It will be China's longest crewed mission to date. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/china-rocket-blasts-off-for-longest-crewed-mission-to-space-station-2576900 (AFP via NDTV)]
*[[Discovery Program]]
** [[Lucy (spacecraft)|Lucy]], a [[NASA]] spacecraft that will visit [[Jupiter trojan|Jupiter's trojan asteroids]] in twelve years, launches at 05:34 [[Eastern Time Zone|EDT]] from [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station|Cape Canaveral]], [[Florida]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/10/16/world/lucy-mission-launch-nasa-scn/index.html (CNN)]
